attchmntText: The Belrise Industries Limited has submitted to the exchange monitoring agency report of IPO and QIP for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report details the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer. The company fully repaid outstanding borrowings amounting to Rs 15,960.21 million. No utilization occurred during the reported quarter for general corporate purposes. Unutilized proceeds of Rs 4.61 million remain for general corporate purposes. Issue expenses utilized Rs 785.71 million, leaving Rs 63.62 million unutilized. The total unutilized amount stands at Rs 68.23 million. The report confirms no deviation from the objects disclosed in the Offer Document. Shareholder approval for material deviations was not applicable. The monitoring agency verified the utilization through peer-reviewed independent chartered accountant certificates and bank statements.

attchmntText: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates on Key Performance Indicators of the Company for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited filed Key Performance Indicators for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with BSE and NSE. The company reported Revenue from Operations of 27,463.82 million rupees, showing a 16.69% growth. EBITDA stood at 3,306.16 million rupees with a margin of 12.04%. Profit After Tax was 1,665.47 million rupees, resulting in a PAT margin of 6.06%. Return on Average Equity was 10.85%, and Return on Average Capital Employed was 15.25%. Revenue breakdown by vehicle type for the quarter included 76.70% from two-wheelers, 2.98% from three-wheelers, 5.44% from passenger four-wheelers, 9.61% from commercial four-wheelers, and 5.27% from others. The data is based on consolidated financials. The submission is also available on the company website under Investor Relations.

attchmntText: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited filed a statement of deviations regarding the utilization of funds raised through its Initial Public Offering and Qualified Institutions Placement for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Audit Committee reviewed the statement on November 13, 2026. For the IPO, which raised Rs. 21,500 million gross proceeds, there were no deviations. Rs. 20,646.06 million of net proceeds were utilized, leaving Rs. 4.61 million unutilized. For the QIP, which raised Rs. 16,999 million gross proceeds, there were no deviations. Rs. 5,320.67 million of net proceeds were utilized, leaving Rs. 11,251.89 million unutilized. The unutilized proceeds have been temporarily invested in bank accounts, deposits, bonds, and commercial paper. The statement is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates on proposed incorporation of SPV under section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the incorporation of a Special Purpose Vehicle under the PM SETU Project on November 13, 2026. The proposed entity will be a subsidiary of Belrise Industries Limited, incorporated under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013, with a charitable object focused on promoting vocational education through the upgradation and management of Industrial Training Institutes. The SPV will be incorporated in India, subject to approval by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. Belrise Industries Limited will hold a 51% shareholding in the new entity. The subscription for shares will be made via cash consideration at a face value of Rs. 10 per share. Further updates regarding the final name and incorporation details will be provided once the SPV is formally registered.

attchmntText: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement between H-One India Private Limited and Belrise Industries Limited
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved a scheme of amalgamation with its wholly owned subsidiary, H-One India Private Limited, on November 13, 2026. The transferor company will merge into the transferee company under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The board also resolved to cancel a previous amalgamation scheme approved on November 11, 2025, withdrawing the earlier intimation. The merger aims to create synergies, streamline operations, and simplify the corporate structure. There is no cash or share consideration involved. As the transferor is a wholly owned subsidiary, the transferee's shares in the subsidiary will be cancelled upon the scheme's effectiveness. There will be no change in the shareholding pattern of Belrise Industries Limited. The scheme is subject to shareholder approval and regulatory clearance.

attchmntText: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release on unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended on Sep 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 was 27,463.8 million rupees, up 16.7% year-on-year. Adjusted profit after tax for Q2 FY27 was 1,662.5 million rupees, representing a 25% year-on-year growth. Manufacturing revenue for the quarter stood at 23,441 million rupees, up 26% year-on-year. The company entered the electronics manufacturing sector with a letter of intent for CNC fixtures from an ecosystem partner of a major American smartphone company. It also secured an incremental order for track beams from a leading global aircraft original equipment manufacturer. Additionally, Belrise Industries signed a license agreement with Yamato Co., Ltd. of Japan for filtration technologies. The results are subject to shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with an earnings call scheduled for November 16, 2026. For Q2 FY27, revenue from operations was 27,463.8 million rupees, up 17 percent year on year. Adjusted profit after tax was 1,662.5 million rupees, up 25 percent. EBITDA stood at 3,306.2 million rupees with a margin of 12.0 percent. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations reached 52,928.5 million rupees, up 15 percent. Adjusted profit after tax was 2,879.2 million rupees, up 18 percent. The company secured orders for complete body and chassis assemblies for a leading three-wheeler model and chassis assemblies for heavy commercial vehicle platforms, with start of production in Q1 FY28. It also entered the consumer electronics sector with an order from an American smartphone company.

attchmntText: Belrise Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended onSeptember 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited board meeting held on November 13, 2026, approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a standalone profit after tax of 1,587.25 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 1,142.68 million in the previous year. Consolidated profit after tax stood at 1,665.47 million for the same period. The board also approved the incorporation of a Special Purpose Vehicle under the PM SETU Project and the execution of the related Shareholders Agreement. Additionally, the board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation between H One India Private Limited and Belrise Industries Limited. This scheme is subject to shareholder approval. The board amended the policy on materiality of related party transactions. An unmodified audit opinion was issued on the financial results.

attchmntText: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited has intimated the schedule for investor and analyst meetings on November 17, 2026. A one-on-one or group meeting with JM Financial is scheduled from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM at Trident BKC, Mumbai. An Avendus Spark meeting is scheduled from 2:00 PM to 6:00 PM at Grand Hyatt, Mumbai. The discussions will be based solely on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information is proposed to be shared. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. The submission is available on the company website under the Investor Relations tab.

attchmntText: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Earnings Conference Call with Analyst/Investors
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call with analysts and investors to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is set for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 09:30 a.m. IST. Key participants include Managing Director Shrikant Badve, President Sumedh Badve, General Manager Swastid Badve, Chief Financial Officer Rahul Ganu, and Chief Marketing Officer Sunil Kulkarni. The presentation will be uploaded to the company website prior to the call. The schedule is subject to change due to business exigencies. Any updates will be communicated via the company website. This intimation is filed under SEBI Listing Regulations.
